query_queue.question: Which NIF material/flags and overrides select each compiled technique, and how are raw specular/gloss/emission/UV/alpha/soft parameters packed?
query_queue.acceptance: Checked flag translation, constant remapping, material-instance overrides, SRV/sampler binding and per-draw selected variant identities.

query_queue.title: Specialized texture transfer
query_queue.question: Which original view and channel semantics reach normal, model-space mask, glow, rim/soft/back, environment and render-target bindings?
query_queue.acceptance: Source slot/override to native texture object/SRV format to GPU slot chain for each selected specialized variant; no semantic-role guess.

query_queue.title: Effective settings and override precedence
query_queue.question: Which active files/plugins/runtime commands write each effective rendering setting, and when do consumers refresh cached copies?
query_queue.acceptance: Loaded paths/order, effective typed values, native consumer reads and refresh/reset timing; compiled initializers remain separate.

query_queue.title: Weather/region/sky selection
query_queue.question: How are climate/region candidates, chance globals, overlap, force-weather and current/next progress selected?
query_queue.acceptance: Checked candidate/priority/state transition rules and live selected records/weights; authored probabilities are not simultaneous color weights.

query_queue.title: Tree and grass producers
query_queue.question: How do TREE/GRAS/LTEX, wind/animation/time, distance fade/alpha and placement data populate actual tree/grass draws?
query_queue.acceptance: Input layouts/constants, population and LOD selection, material permutations and active draw receipts; existing static meshes are insufficient.

query_queue.title: Water and volumetric inputs
query_queue.question: How do water surfaces/depth/refraction/reflection/flow and volumetric density/scattering/quality state reach all active resources?
query_queue.acceptance: Record-to-material/constant/texture chains and selected pass resources; recovered atmospheric fog subset must remain separate.

query_queue.title: Animation, skin, morph and particles
query_queue.question: Which controller/bone/morph/simulation streams alter vertices/materials and how are they shared with depth/shadow/motion passes?
query_queue.acceptance: Checked source decoding, time ownership, CPU/GPU deformation layouts and color/depth/shadow draw correspondence for each family.

query_queue.title: Overrides, decals and projected surfaces
query_queue.question: What precedence replaces textures/material parameters and what native blend/depth/bias/culling/projector state results?
query_queue.acceptance: Checked override winner and source slot remapping; exact active raster/depth/blend state attached to representative draw variants.

query_queue.title: Reflection/environment/skin/hair/snow/parallax
query_queue.question: Which special inputs/coordinates/transfer/functions and bug-state apply to each distinct specialized material?
query_queue.acceptance: Selected target shader arithmetic plus checked CPU parameters/SRV transfer and native draw evidence for each branch independently.

query_queue.title: Camera and scene ownership
query_queue.question: How do main/first-person/reflection/map/menu view matrices, clipping, render origin and scene graph index select effective inputs?
query_queue.acceptance: Checked per-view lifecycle/order and concrete constant/resource identity snapshots; no global-state alias between incompatible views.

verified: Stream loader writes raw scalar destinations+0x70/+0x80/+0x84/+0x88/+0x8C/+0x90/+0x94 and raw RGB+0x38/+0x3C/+0x40 without normalization arithmetic in these helpers.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Native legacy diffuse transfer versus historical semantic PBR policy
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: I-E07 target-native texture/SRV proof governs native legacy diffuse. I-E18 semantic sRGB policy describes a project compatibility role and does not establish native view transfer.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Prior runtime guide names noon trajectory circular/unresolved
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: I-E05 now closes full-mode local trajectory arithmetic, but live Sky parent/overrides/exceptional modes remain open.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Historical shader parser stops after primary families
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: I-E01 later validates complete 16,044-program stage/extent inventory. This does not make every family semantic or live binding complete.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Zero-filled ambient-builder RGB operand and initialized sun dimmer
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: Operand meaning may be mutable state or a shared sentinel; initial storage and dimmer initialization do not establish effective runtime coefficients.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Source-qualified diffuse annotations and rendering acceptance
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: I-E08 inventory/migration counts are file views and do not prove visible native draws, appearance improvement or retail parity.

cross_audit_reconciliation.issue: Provisional package-order labels and compatible selected material interfaces
cross_audit_reconciliation.resolution: I-E32 now closes native Lighting constructor/global/ordered section, exact metadata/payload and serialized-key lookup-to-bind when the pinned package supplies the opened resource. Earlier provisional labels are superseded only for this static association; active file and draw remain unobserved.
